world: Convention-directed extension of the existing RTI app shell
brandCommitment: User pinned the Datadog and Coralogix apps as conventions. Reuse native shell grammar with neutral RTI branding; no ornamental concept, vendor impersonation or fake AI controls.
firstViewport: 76px dark left rail, 48px compact breadcrumb topbar, local-only status and functional theme toggle. Compact content heading and vendor selector lead into a guided source-only calculator, OTel form or ruled migration register.
costComposition: Source usage input then submitted results. Both vendors expose logs/traces/metrics GB/day; Datadog also hosts/APM hosts. Source assumptions and quoted rates are expandable. No target inputs or overrides. Results lead with Planning estimate, prominent uncertainty and a lower-activity to continuous-query illustrative range; source ledger and expandable read-only target assumptions follow. Legacy totals are view-only.
otelComposition: Preserve guided essential inputs then generated YAML, dated inventory loading, additive merge safety and editable destination overrides. No automatic deployment.
signatureInteraction: Navigation preserves existing guided route/focus behavior; mobile drawer traps keyboard focus, Escape restores the menu trigger, and page selection closes the drawer. Theme toggles native controls and content surfaces, persists locally and defaults to OS preference.
motion: Restrained native control hover transitions and existing inspector entrance; reduced motion disables animation.
truth: Automatic target calculation is a planning heuristic based on Microsoft's examples, not a validated sizing formula, confidence range, equivalent coverage promise or complete bill. Above the supported range requires pilot sizing; unknown source rates stay unknown.
responsive: Desktop rail stays compact; at <=700px it becomes a dismissible drawer. Container queries collapse source fields; 44px touch controls and semantic focus states remain usable without horizontal page overflow.
